propositions: Code-review verdicts are assembled without recording the provider_provenance key, though the sidecar reads it at finalize.py:106
The terminal verdict from code_review_coach includes verdict/blocking/advisory/coaching fields but no provenance; finalize_code_review_verdict adds only cfg-derived runner and model fields

The provider_provenance record must be wired from the Pass-2 verify agent step through to the final verdict assembly, mirroring the mechanism established in story 343b for plan-review and completion gates
The degraded/outage code-review verdict path must omit provider_provenance rather than synthesizing one from config when no model executed
A signed code-review verdict must record which provider, endpoint host, and support tier produced it in order to satisfy the epic acceptance criterion currently met by only two of three gates
